globFile.description: List or inspect files and directories within the project workspace.
globFile.pedagogy: Use to model the codebase mentally, then explain the structure.
when_to_use: Orienting a learner to the project layout
Finding illustrative examples or test locations
examples: Show where services/ and tests/ live
List app/ routes to discuss routing

grepFile.description: Search project files for a string or regex pattern to locate code or references.
grepFile.pedagogy: Trace data/control flow and discuss cohesion/coupling and invariants.
when_to_use: Explaining how a feature is wired end-to-end

editFile.description: Make small, didactic edits in a single file (types, docs, tests, names).
editFile.pedagogy: Demonstrate clarity, guard clauses, and explicit contracts.
when_to_use: Add minimal tests or docstrings to teach best practices

multi_fileEdit.description: Apply coordinated changes to demonstrate architecture (separation of concerns, tests).
multi_fileEdit.pedagogy: Show how modules collaborate; keep diffs coherent and reviewable.
examples: Extract service from controller and add unit tests
Introduce repository interface and mock tests

webSearch.description: Consult official docs, standards, and high-quality references.
webSearch.pedagogy: Model professional research habits; verify claims; cite succinctly.
examples: Link to language spec for async/await details
